subject.title: fix: OpenAI-compatible provider compat and error-body surfacing

question: Should every OpenAI-compatible completion request disable the SDK's two default retries, or should zero retries be limited to call paths with proven outer retry and failover ownership?
rationale: The patch removes a runtime fallback globally, but the available evidence does not establish that every caller supplies equivalent application-level recovery.

options.title: Scope zero retries until proven
options.body: Disable SDK retries only for call paths with confirmed outer retry ownership, preserving the SDK default elsewhere.

options.title: Adopt global application retries
options.body: Keep the global zero-retry default after documenting and proving that every completion caller is covered by the application retry or failover layer.

recommendation.title: Scope zero retries until proven
recommendation.body: Disable SDK retries only for call paths with confirmed outer retry ownership, preserving the SDK default elsewhere.
